224:t_3:27.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And beyond here... there's information about the end of the universe...」

224:t_3:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you... $$プロトカルチャー$$...?」

224:t_3:34.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「I am one who sleeps here, charged with preserving the words left by the $$プロトカルチャー$$ and conveying them to future generations.」

224:t_3:35.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「When one who is proof of peace touches it, the door opens and I awaken from my slumber.」

224:t_3:37.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Tell us, will of the $$プロトカルチャー$$. What exactly is this end of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years?」

224:t_3:38.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「I shall answer. That too is what I must convey.」

224:t_3:39.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「The end of the universe... It consists of erasing the power of life from the universe.」

224:t_3:42.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Does the power of life refer to the 《$$アニマスピリチア$$》 that sealed the $$プロトデビルン$$?」

224:t_3:43.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Naturally, that is included. But the power of life is more universal... All living things possess it.」

224:t_3:44.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「It is also the key to drawing out that which governs the laws of all things... the $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

224:t_3:47.en:
$n
「It's true that the $$スフィア$$ also draws out $$次元力$$ through human feelings and hearts, but...」

224:t_3:48.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I see... I'm starting to understand.)

224:t_3:50.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Once every 12,000 years, the universe seeks to be reborn.」

224:t_3:51.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist... These two energies collide...」

224:t_3:52.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish attempts to erase the power of life.」

224:t_3:53.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「That gives birth to $$バアル$$.」

224:t_3:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「So the end of the universe and $$バアル$$ were connected after all...!」

224:t_3:56.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「But life does not perish... Through blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire, and the radiance of the sun, it walks the path of $$シンカ$$...」

224:t_3:58.en:
$$アルト$$
「Tell us. What do they mean?」

224:t_3:59.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「$$シンカ$$ is not something another can teach you. You must reach it through your own strength.」

224:t_3:60.en:
$n
「You're saying the same thing as the god $$ゼウス$$...!」

224:t_3:61.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Those who open the door to $$シンカ$$ stand against the end of the universe... That will become the power to overcome the true end that will eventually come...」

224:t_3:63.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「After 12,000 years has repeated 10,000 times, the universe meets its true end... the great collapse.」

224:t_3:64.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「That is the final battle... The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist stake everything upon their collision...」

224:t_3:65.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「It engulfs every parallel world in existence.」

224:t_3:67.en:
$$セツコ$$
「12,000 years, 10,000 times... That means 120 million years...」

224:t_3:68.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「The power to overcome that is... the pinnacle of $$シンカ$$... In other words, the power of a god...」

224:t_3:69.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Gods and demons... The battle between higher life-forms and $$バアル$$... That is the means to overcome the end...」

224:t_3:70.en:
$$アルト$$
「A battle between gods and demons...」

224:t_3:71.en:
$n
「Is that what the $$ミケーネ$$ gods were talking about...?」

224:t_3:72.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「But there is one who has forgotten the mission of the higher life-forms. That one... claims to be an emissary of God...」

224:t_3:73.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Oh! My will... My memories...!」

224:t_3:74.en:
$n
「Wait! We still have questions we want to ask!」

224:t_3:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! We're getting out!」

224:t_3:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「Take $$ランカ$$ aboard your machine」
「Take $$ランカ$$ aboard $$ブレラ$$'s machine」

224:t_3:81.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yes...! I'm counting on you, $$アルト$$!」

224:t_3:82.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$! I'm counting on you to take care of $$ランカ$$!」

224:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$アルト$$. You were splendid today.」

224:t_10:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「I had $$ランカ$$ sitting behind me. I couldn't let myself get shot down.」

224:t_10:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, but I'm heading out again right away. If you want to talk, make it later.」

224:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Did you notice, $$アルト$$? Your heart stirred when you took $$ランカ$$ aboard your machine...」

224:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a robot, I can't tell what sort of feelings they were, but they produced 100 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$.」

224:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add that to the team's stock. And I'll continue following where your hearts lead, $$アルト$$, $$ランカ$$... and $$シェリル$$.」

224:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The day those three settle their relationship... Whatever answer they find, I'm sure it will produce a great many $$Ｚチップ$$...」

224:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$ブレラ$$. You were splendid today.」

224:t_10:14.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I had $$ランカ$$ aboard... Mistakes weren't an option.」

224:t_10:15.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「If you don't need anything, I'm leaving. We have another sortie right away.」

224:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is his bluntness hiding embarrassment...? But he certainly does have love for $$ランカ$$ in his heart.」

224:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That produced 100 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$. I'll add it to the team's stock.」

224:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But $$ランカ$$ is a grown woman now too. There are parts of her world even a brother cannot enter.」

224:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アルト$$, $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$...」

224:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The day those three settle their relationship... Whatever answer they find, I'm sure it will produce a great many $$Ｚチップ$$...」

224:t_10:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ランカ$$... You're able to sing again.」

224:t_10:26.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yes... I'm sorry for worrying you all this time, Big Bro.」

224:t_10:29.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You've reunited with $$ブレラ$$ too. You don't have to force yourself to call me Big Bro anymore.」

224:t_10:30.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You could even change your name to $$ランカ・スターン$$...」

224:t_10:33.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Why would you say something so sad...? You're both my big brothers...」
